reviews_5s: I'm a tobacco afficionado. I got this for processing my tobacco. I grow and cure my own tobacco for pipe and home-roll purposes but my original plan to pulverize it by hand was not working out well. My product was not burning evenly in my pipe and it was too odd-shaped to work in a tube or cigarette tube, so I started looking for a uniform solution. This grinder renders the tobacco down to a fine powder. Occasionally, the leaf material can get caught up around the edges and in the teeth, making it hard to turn. In that case, I open it, use the included plastic cleaner tool to dislodge the blockage, and it works fine. If you have a lot of material to grind it gets a bit labor intensive, so I might eventually upgrade to one of the hand crank models. It feels like decent quality, it was affordable, and it doesn't take up much space. Give it a try.I like the screen and the compartment on the bottom for the good stuff. Gets the job done. Material is nice and sturdy and grinds well. Good purchase for the amount paid. Nice and small. Easy to storeJust as described, works great, and quick shipperGreat size and works well. I’ve had it for a few years now and still functions like new. I will say the part where the ground up herbs fall into is a little shallow, so maybe not ideal if you need to grind large quantities at a time.
